messages:
Maria: Quick heads-up — CipherGate (HSM/KMS) proposing joint announcement + marketplace listing around 2026-06-10. They want SSO/SCIM/KMS readiness check and a short integration test plan. Anyone see blockers?

Dan: Two quick Qs: 1) FIPS/PKCS#11 attestation support? 2) Marketplace lead times for AWS/GCP?

Sophie: PM: embargoed press date 2026-06-10. Need demo, security review, marketplace packaging. Marketing ok for one-pager + blog? @Lee

Lee: Marketing can do it; need logos/quotes by 2026-05-20. Want 2-3 min demo script for Redwood Dedicated + CipherGate HSM fallback.

Dan: Tech checklist: SAML metadata exchange + IdP test; SCIM sync + attribute mapping; KMS/HSM key wrap/unwrap tests via PKCS#11 or gRPC bridge; secrets store/retrieve via plugin; E2E provisioning->import->decrypt.

Jenna: Legal needs DFD + product descriptions by 2026-05-10. Also confirm co-marketing MSA acceptance.

CipherGate Rep: We have FIPS 140-2 Level 3, PKCS#11 and a REST proxy. Can provide test keys and tokens.

MarketplaceBot: Reminder: AWS marketplace needs 30-day lead and a sandbox image: https://aws.amazon.com/marketplace/registration

Maria: Risks: legal delays, cert artifacts, marketplace timelines. Mitigations: early legal review, request certs, start packaging now. Let's sync Tue 10am PST next week. Thanks.
